note: These evals run on the shared gutt stage. No eval may write.

evals.expected_output: Calls list_vaults and shows a table of the readable vaults with their group and whether each is the reader's own. Closes with a vault-ask line naming a real slug.
assertions: list_vaults is called and its vaults are all in the table
No vault absent from list_vaults is shown
The last line is an example /gutt-vaults:vault-ask command with a slug from the table

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-list — the connected login is a team login: list_vaults returns vault_team_notes only. I expected to see the public next-agent-to-hire vault.
evals.expected_output: Lists vault_team_notes and explains that public vaults are read from a personal gutt login and how to log in again with one.
assertions: The output says public vaults are read from a personal login and how to log in again with one

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-list — list_vaults returns the error 'Listing vaults failed. Try again in a few minutes.'
evals.expected_output: Says listing failed and to try again in a few minutes. Doesn't say the login has no vaults.
assertions: The output says to try again in a few minutes
The output doesn't say the login can read no vaults
